units.source_text: 这时，电车从鸣泷附近的大竹林边上驶了过去。

en.t: At that moment, the train passed along the edge of a great bamboo grove near Narutaki.

units.source_text: 5月是竹子正凋零的季节，竹叶呈现一片枯黄。

en.t: May was the season when bamboo was just withering, and the bamboo leaves had turned a broad expanse of dry yellow.

units.source_text: 风微微摇曳着竹梢，枯叶落在密密麻麻的竹丛中，

en.t: The wind faintly swayed the bamboo tips, and dead leaves fell into the dense thickets of bamboo,

units.source_text: 可是竹子下都仿佛与民毫无关系，

en.t: yet beneath the bamboo everything seemed to have nothing at all to do with human life,

units.source_text: 粗大的报节盘根错节地延伸到竹林的深处，平平静静的。

en.t: the thick joints and tangled roots stretched deep into the bamboo grove, utterly still and calm.

units.source_text: 只有靠近铁路的竹子，在电车疾驰而过的时候，才猛烈地摇曳着。

en.t: Only the bamboo near the railway shook violently when the train rushed past.

units.source_text: 其中一株格外青翠而娇出，它残留在我的眼里。

en.t: Among them, one stalk was especially green and delicately striking, and it remained in my eyes.

units.source_text: 这株猛烈摇曳的竹子的袅娜姿态，以娇艳而奇异的运动印象，

en.t: The graceful figure of that violently swaying bamboo, as an impression of gorgeous and strange motion,

units.source_text: 留在我的脑海里，然后渐渐远去乃至消逝……

en.t: remained in my mind, then gradually receded until it vanished...
